notes.title: Star Shift Updated to Version 0.6!
notes.notes:
Star Shift has been updated to 0.6. This is a big update that makes many changes to the core gameplay. Version 0.6 comes with a complete graphical overhaul, as well as the addition of a new skill tree system which allows the player to learn skills from various disciplines in the order they choose. 

[previewyoutube=3T8wFcQrdnk;full][/previewyoutube]

New stories have been added including the latest story which is a crossover story between Star Shift and Killer Gin (another game). Here is a sample of that crossover story, added to this latest version of the game. 

[previewyoutube=YZF4GKZ7XbI;full][/previewyoutube]

CHANGELOG:
1. Rebalancing change
2. Massive Graphical Overhauls
3. Storyline Additions
4. Various bug fixes
5. Class change system replaced with Skill Tree System
6. Mercenary Class replaced with Rogue Class. 
7. Tactical Combat performance improvement
8. Tactical combat transitioned from single units to armies.

notes.title: Star Shift 0.39 Update
notes.notes:
Thank you to everybody who has alpha tested our game so far. A number of small bugs have been brought to our attention and they are now patched with this update. 


1. First level being too hard.
2. Items not disappearing when used in battle.
3. Addition of item drops for enemies.
4. Walking through walls on certain maps.

As a workaround for now, if you experience combat balancing difficulties, there's a difficulty slider in the options menu. 

Version 0.4 will be coming out in a few weeks and will have many more improvements added. The 0.39 build fixes the biggest 0.38 bugs.

Thank You,
Psychronic Game Studios

notes.title: Star Shift 0.38 Update!
notes.notes:
Star-Shift has been updated to version 0.38. This update adds many fixes to the core gameplay. This video shows a basic introduction and early gameplay of the game. If interested, please check it out. The demo on Steam is about 3 hours of early gameplay. The full game will be much longer, but will give you the basic feel/concept of the game. 

Change Log:

- Added Class/Job System with trainable skills
- Additional storyline and side-quests
- Improvements to the tactical battle system
- More tactical battles
- Added base building/outpost
- More random ships living in each solar system/doing things
- Additional shops/items/weapons/armor
- Combat balancing changes
- Various lag improvements
